Notice
Gandhi Jayanti centralized celebration will be held online on October 02, 2026 at
11.00 A.M. on Google Meet. All the members of the Senate, Syndicate, teachers,
Oficers and non-teaching employees are cordially requested to join the link which
will be sent to the members on their official emails. Prof. Shefali Roy, Dean, Faculty
of Social Science, Patna University will be the convenor of Gandhi Jayanti
celebration.
By order of the Hon'ble Vice Chancellor,
